decisions.reason: As a core garage-door-operator line with several models, it likely has become part of the firm's standard offering, so the upside of retaining it still outweighs the relatively low carrying cost.

After several years, the uncertainty around this lower-prominence glazed industrial sectional door should be largely resolved, and its overlap with other industrial door variants makes it the most likely option to rationalize.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits the firm's compliance- and performance-driven industrial portfolio well, so it remains a worthwhile product to keep unless demand has clearly disappointed.
Its stronger initial commercial commitment and close fit with the firm's industrial door systems suggest it still offers enough value to retain rather than withdraw.
